entries.name: Anime Style
entries.copy_prompt: Contemporary anime illustration with confident, simplified contours, appealing stylized proportions, and large expressive eyes. Use bright flat colors and clear cel-shaded shadow shapes, keeping internal detail economical and every form immediately readable.
entries.copy_tags: Anime Style

entries.name: 8-Bit Pixel Art
entries.copy_prompt: 8-bit pixel art built from discrete, grid-aligned square pixels and a tightly limited palette. Reduce forms to clear blocky silhouettes, using stepped color bands and deliberate pixel clusters for shading, with hard edges and no antialiasing.
entries.copy_tags: 8-Bit Pixel Art

entries.name: Pixar Animation
entries.copy_prompt: Pixar-inspired 3D animation rendering with appealing rounded proportions, smooth volumetric modeling, and warm subsurface scattering in skin. Gentle three-point lighting, soft shadows, and subtle ambient occlusion give the forms dimensional weight while preserving a soft, inviting finish.
entries.copy_tags: Pixar Animation

entries.name: Low-Poly 3D
entries.copy_prompt: Low-poly rendering with visibly triangulated geometry and angular, simplified forms. Flat-shaded polygon faces create hard tonal changes between adjoining facets, replacing smooth gradients and curved surfaces with a clean geometric structure and deliberately reduced detail.
entries.copy_tags: Low-Poly 3D

entries.name: Paper Cutout
entries.copy_prompt: Layered paper-cutout rendering with flat, sharply cut shapes stacked at slightly different depths. Use clean silhouettes, subtle paper texture, and narrow drop shadows between overlapping layers, creating tactile dimensionality through physical separation rather than drawn outlines or blended shading.
entries.copy_tags: Paper Cutout

entries.name: Claymation
entries.copy_prompt: Handcrafted claymation rendering with soft, rounded forms, slight asymmetry, and visible fingerprint dents. Preserve small surface irregularities and hand-shaped contours, using warm, even light and gentle contact shadows to give the clay a tangible, softly modeled appearance.
entries.copy_tags: Claymation

entries.name: Watercolor Painting (MOSS caption test)
entries.copy_prompt: A transparent watercolor painting on textured cold-pressed paper, with luminous cream paper visible through thin layers of color. Soft wet-on-wet edges, delicate pigment blooms, fine granulation and subtle darker pools of pigment create the forms. Transparent blue-gray washes shape the shadows, while a few crisp dry-brush accents define the focal details.
entries.copy_tags: Watercolor Painting

entries.name: Line Art
entries.copy_prompt: A clean contour-line illustration in black ink on white paper. Describe the adult woman's face, hands, clothing folds, flowers and furniture with deliberate tapered lines and generous open white areas. Keep the forms readable through line weight and overlapping contours, with almost no filled color, tonal gradients or modeled shadow masses.
entries.copy_tags: Line Art

entries.name: Colored Pencil Drawing
entries.copy_prompt: A colored-pencil drawing on lightly textured cream paper. Fine directional pencil strokes follow the face, hands, hair and cloth, with layered translucent hatching building soft volume. Preserve visible paper grain between the colored marks, delicate outlines and small burnished highlights, using ochre, blue, yellow and warm brown pencils rather than smooth digital fills.
entries.copy_tags: Colored Pencil Drawing

entries.name: Stained Glass Art
entries.copy_prompt: A luminous stained-glass panel depicting the adult woman arranging flowers. Dark lead cames outline carefully shaped pieces of cream, amber, blue and green glass, dividing the face, hands, clothing and workshop into expressive colored segments. Uneven glass thickness, tiny bubbles and transmitted window light create rich color without painted three-dimensional shading.
entries.copy_tags: Stained Glass Art

entries.name: Sumi-e Ink Painting
entries.copy_prompt: An expressive East Asian ink-wash painting on absorbent rice paper. Broad diluted ink washes establish the workshop and clothing, while a few dark calligraphic brushstrokes define the adult woman's face, hands, hair and flowers. Let wet edges bleed into pale paper and dry strokes break into visible fibers, using carefully reserved white space instead of continuous tonal rendering.
entries.copy_tags: Sumi-e Ink

entries.name: Rembrandt (MOSS caption test)
entries.copy_prompt: An oil painting in the style of Rembrandt, with a restrained palette of warm umber, ochre and muted gold. Build illuminated skin and fabric with thick, textured impasto, while keeping the deep brown shadows thinly glazed. Use softly lost edges, subtle reflected light and rich tonal transitions to create rounded, weighty forms. Concentrated directional window light reveals the face and hands against a subdued interior. Preserve visible brushwork and a tactile painted surface throughout.
entries.copy_tags: Rembrandt

entries.name: Claude Monet Style
entries.copy_prompt: An oil painting in the style of Claude Monet, with broken touches of luminous color and softly dissolving contours. Build the woman's face, flowers and workshop from interwoven cream, lavender, pale blue, green and warm yellow brushmarks. Let reflected daylight unify the forms, keeping shadows colorful and airy and allowing adjacent strokes to remain visible rather than blending into smooth photographic detail.
entries.copy_tags: Claude Monet

entries.name: Vincent van Gogh Style
entries.copy_prompt: An oil painting in the style of Vincent van Gogh, with thick ridged impasto and strongly directional brushstrokes. Rhythmic curves describe the woman's hair, clothing folds, flowers and workshop surfaces, while saturated ochre, cobalt blue, green and warm cream create expressive color contrasts. Use clear dark accents and vigorously worked paint to give familiar forms a tactile, pulsing structure.
entries.copy_tags: Vincent van Gogh

entries.name: Gustav Klimt Style
entries.copy_prompt: A painting in the style of Gustav Klimt, combining sensitively modeled facial features and hands with decorative flattened clothing and surroundings. Gold-leaf-like surfaces, small mosaic rectangles, curling botanical motifs and densely repeated geometric patterns fill the apron and workshop. Keep the face and bouquet readable amid warm gold, deep blue, cream and green ornamental fields.
entries.copy_tags: Gustav Klimt

entries.name: Alphonse Mucha Style
entries.copy_prompt: An illustration in the style of Alphonse Mucha, with graceful continuous contours, an elegantly simplified adult face and flowing curved hair and fabric. Muted cream, sage, ochre and dusty blue color areas are enclosed by clean decorative lines. Integrate restrained floral ornament and rhythmic curved shapes into the existing workshop, preserving the woman's action without adding a title or lettering.
entries.copy_tags: Alphonse Mucha

entries.name: Takashi Murakami Style
entries.copy_prompt: An illustration in the style of Takashi Murakami and Superflat, with precise cartoon contours, brilliant flat color fields, clean graphic shapes and deliberately shallow pictorial space. Simplify the woman, bouquet and workshop into a coherent, highly saturated two-dimensional composition. Use sharply separated colors and playful stylized facial features throughout, rather than merely adding a decorative flower pattern to a realistic scene.
entries.copy_tags: Takashi Murakami

entries.name: Yayoi Kusama Style
entries.copy_prompt: A painting in the style of Yayoi Kusama, where the woman, bouquet and interior are reconstructed as flattened organic shapes interwoven with dense repeating dots and infinity-net patterns. Use vivid contrasting fields of yellow, red, black and white, with rhythmic irregular spots and looping mesh-like contours. Let the repeated structures define the face, hands, clothing and flowers themselves, rather than merely decorating a realistic figure. Preserve the single woman and her flower-arranging gesture.
entries.copy_tags: Yayoi Kusama

entries.name: Andy Warhol Style
entries.copy_prompt: A portrait-centered silkscreen artwork in the style of Andy Warhol. Reduce the adult woman's face, hands, clothes and flower workshop to bold high-contrast photographic stencil shapes over sharply separated areas of vivid flat color. Retain uneven ink coverage and small registration offsets within the printed forms, producing a single coherent image rather than a grid of repeated portraits.
entries.copy_tags: Andy Warhol

entries.name: Banksy Style
entries.copy_prompt: A street-art stencil in the style of Banksy, portraying the woman, her hands and the bouquet as sharply cut black-and-white silhouettes with selective interior cutouts. Use a small accent of yellow on the flowers against a pale, subtly weathered wall. Reduce the workshop to a few decisive stencil shapes, with sparse spray-painted edges and strong graphic negative space. Transform the figure itself into stencil art rather than placing a realistic portrait in front of graffiti.
entries.copy_tags: Banksy

entries.name: Ancient Egyptian Wall Painting
entries.copy_prompt: An ancient Egyptian wall painting on pale plaster, with precise dark contours and flat areas of ochre, red, blue, green and cream mineral color. Translate the adult woman's anatomy into Egyptian composite-view conventions: a profile face with a front-facing eye, broad frontal shoulders and clearly separated arms and hands. Flatten the workshop and bouquet into carefully arranged painted shapes without photographic perspective or modeled shading.
entries.copy_tags: Ancient Egyptian Wall

entries.name: Wayang Kulit Shadow Theatre
entries.copy_prompt: A scene rendered as Indonesian wayang kulit shadow theatre, with the woman reconstructed as an articulated flat leather puppet in an elegant elongated profile. Use slender jointed arms, delicately pierced ornamental shapes, visible thin control rods and a warm backlit cloth screen. Make the bouquet and worktable legible through carefully cut silhouettes and small openings. The figure and objects share the same flat theatrical construction, with dark shadows and warm light shining through the pierced leather.
entries.copy_tags: Wayang Kulit Shadow Theatre

entries.name: The Simpsons Style
entries.copy_prompt: A Simpsons-inspired two-dimensional animation frame with warm yellow skin, large round eyes, rounded cartoon construction and heavy clean outlines. Uniform primary-color fills and a few simple cel-shadow shapes keep the figures and workshop graphic and immediately readable.
entries.copy_tags: The Simpsons Style

entries.name: Sesame Street-style Soft Puppet
entries.copy_prompt: A Sesame Street-style practical puppet scene, with the woman transformed into one friendly foam-and-fleece hand puppet. Give her a broad flexible felt mouth, protruding round eyes, a softly rounded fabric head, short dark yarn hair and soft rod-operated hands. Retain the cream shirt and navy apron as sewn miniature garments. Show tactile fleece fibers, fabric seams and a handmade miniature flower-workshop set, with the puppet actively arranging the bouquet. One puppet only.
entries.copy_tags: Sesame Street-style Soft Puppet
